text: Verified by Mirko Vorreuter on October 8, 2025 Mirko is an immigration lawyer in Berlin. Mirko is an immigration lawyer in Berlin. This guide explains how the Fiktionsbescheinigung works, how to apply for it, and how to travel with an expired residence permit.

It takes 3 to 6 months to get a new residence permit. If your visa or residence permit expires while you wait, nothing happens. Your residence status stays valid until your application is approved or rejected. You can still live, work, study and freelance like before. The Fiktionsbescheinigung proves that your residence status is still valid, even if your visa or residence permit has expired. It’s not a permit, only a confirmation. Your residence status stays valid even without a Fiktionsbescheinigung. The Fiktionsbescheinigung proves that… You can stay in Germany with an expired visa or residence permit You can travel abroad and return to Germany with an expired residence permit You can work, study or freelance while you wait for the immigration office

Ask the Ausländerbehörde for it… With your residence permit application Ask for a Fiktionsbescheinigung in your application message. Include proof of your travel plans. During your appointment Explain that you must travel outside of Germany, and that you need a Fiktionsbescheinigung for this. Bring proof of your travel plans. By email Contact the Ausländerbehörde. Explain your travel plans, and why you need a Fiktionsbescheinigung. If you must travel in a few weeks, use the emergency form. In Berlin, you can get a Fiktionsbescheinigung if… you have applied for a residence permit, permanent residence or citizenship and your current residence permit expires in less than 6 weeks and you have an important reason to travel (like a business trip or a conference) and you include proof of your travel plans (like flight tickets or invitations) In Berlin, they often refuse to give you a Fiktionsbescheinigung. This is illegal. You have the right to get this document, even if you don’t have travel plans or plane tickets. [Fiona Macdonald, immigration lawyer (December 2023), Facebook (October 2022), § 81 Abs. 5 AufenthG, confirmed by a relocation consultant (October 2023), M 25 E 16.2114 (Munich, 2020), 18 B 850/19 (NRW, 2019), Facebook (November 2023), Facebook (October 2023)] I asked them 5 times before they gave me one. You can hire an immigration lawyer to force them, but it costs € 1,000 to € 2,000. They might send your Fiktionsbescheinigung by post, or you might need to pick it up at the Ausländerbehörde. There is sometimes a € 13 fee. [VAB 81.5, § 47 Abs. 1 S. 8 AufenthV] Remember, the Fiktionsbescheinigung is only a confirmation. Your residence status stays valid without it. You mostly need this document to travel with an expired residence permit, but some people can travel without a Fiktionsbescheinigung. If you currently have a tourist visa, you can’t get a Fiktionsbescheinigung. Usually, you can’t convert a Schengen visa to a residence permit. You must apply for a residence permit in your home country.

You can travel outside of Germany if your Fiktionsbescheinigung says… der Aufenthaltstitel als fortbestehend (§ 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG). or Die Inhaber / die Inhaberin hat die Dokumentation eines Aufenthaltsrechts nach dem FreizügG/EU oder dem Abkommen EU-Schweiz beantragt, das hiermit vorläufig bescheinigt wird Other types of Fiktionsbescheinigung do not let you travel outside of Germany. If you travel outside Germany, you might not be able to re-enter later. Fiktionsbescheinigung types You might still have problems when you return to Germany. Airline employees and foreign border agents might not recognise your Fiktionsbescheinigung. If you can, take a direct flight to Germany, and only deal with the German border police. They are better informed. You must return to Germany before your Fiktionsbescheinigung expires. If it expires in less than 1 week, some airlines will not let you fly to Germany.

If you are a citizen of Australia, Canada, Israel, Japan, New Zealand, South Korea, the United Kingdom, the United States, Andorra, Brazil, El Salvador, Honduras, Monaco or San Marino, you can travel without a Fiktionsbescheinigung. You can re-enter Germany with an expired residence permit. [Immigration lawyer (December 2023), Bundespolizei (December 2023), Bundespolizei (November 2023), Bundespolizei (October 2022), § 41 Abs. 1 and 3 AufenthV, Facebook (October 2022), an American reader (January 2024), my own experience (April 2024), Bundespolizei (November 2025)] This is confirmed by the Bundespolizei, a few travellers, and my own experience. [Immigration lawyer (December 2023), Bundespolizei (December 2023), Bundespolizei (November 2023), Bundespolizei (October 2022), § 41 Abs. 1 and 3 AufenthV, Facebook (October 2022), an American reader (January 2024), my own experience (April 2024), Bundespolizei (November 2025)] It’s not guaranteed to work for you. The rules can change at any time. Ask the Bundespolizei before you travel. Bring proof of your residence permit application. It can help you if you have problems with the border police.

There are 4 types of Fiktionsbescheinigung: [§ 81 AufenthG, Fem.os (September 2019), Wikipedia, Berlin.de, se-legal.de, unternehmen-integrieren-fluechtlinge.de (November 2023)] § 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG If you have a residence permit or a National Visa, and you want to renew it or get another residence permit. It allows you to travel outside of Germany. § 81 Abs. 3 Satz 1 AufenthG If you entered Germany without a visa, and you applied for a residence permit on time. It does not allow you to travel outside of Germany. § 81 Abs. 3 Satz 2 AufenthG If you entered Germany without a visa, and you applied late for a residence permit. It does not allow you to travel outside of Germany. FreizügG/EU oder Abkommen EU-Schweiz It allows you to travel outside of Germany. The type is written on your Fiktionsbescheinigung is written on it. It’s the box that has an ‘X’ on it, not the lines that are covered with ‘XXXXXXXXX’.
Your Fiktionsbescheinigung is valid until your residence permit application is approved or rejected. [§ 81 AufenthG] It has an expiration date, but it can be renewed.
